title: lithodora zahnii
intro: Lithodora zahnii, commonly known as Lithodora, is a flowering plant species in the borage family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithodora are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Lithodora zahnii.
